[SWS_CM_00049] Aborting method calls in case of detected unspecified E2E error
⌈
To notify the adaptive application about a detected unspecified E2E error which is
returned from an issued (remote) service method call, the ara::com implementation
shall make the ara::core::Future returned by the function call operator() of
the respective Method class (see [SWS_CM_00196]) ready by invoking the SetEr-
ror (see [SWS_CORE_00353]) operation of the Promise corresponding to this Fu-
ture with an ara::core::ErrorCode (see [SWS_CORE_00501]) where the error
domain is set to ara::com::e2e::ComE2EErrorDomain (see [SWS_CM_12503])
and the value is set to kUnspecifiedE2EError (see [SWS_CM_10474]) as an ar-
gument.
⌋

[SWS_CM_00049] Aborting method calls in case of detected unspecified E2E error
⌈
To notify the adaptive application about a detected unspecified E2E error which

tor() of the respective Method class (see [SWS_CM_00196]) ready by invoking
the SetError (see [SWS_CORE_00353]) operation of the Promise correspond-
ing to this Future with an ara::core::ErrorCode (see [SWS_CORE_00501])
where the error domain is set to ara::com::e2e::ComE2EErrorDomain (see

(see [SWS_CM_10474]) as an argument.
⌋
